next_action.summary: Implement delegate attachments (FND-0011): `orchestrate delegate --attach <glob>` (and delegate(attachments=[...])) reads the named files from the pinned cwd, caps total size (policy budget, e.g. 60k characters), wraps each in a datamarked untrusted-data block (spotlighting, PA-camel/Hines et al.), and marks the task self-contained so API workers (role inline) may serve it. Add eval support: a route variant suffix '+attach' that attaches the case file's fixture_dir/attach_glob. Measure with `orchestrate eval --suite EVS-SECURITY --incumbent codex@fast --route codex@fast+attach --samples 3` (<= 6 calls) and record an EVR with tokens, latency and accuracy; if noninferior on accuracy and cheaper, document it as the preferred mode for known-input tasks in ENTRYPOINT step 3. Keep attachments out of the engine's coding workers for now.
